$schema.description: The JSON schema reference for validation.

specFiles.description: Relative or absolute paths to OpenAPI spec files (JSON or YAML) to validate requests and responses against.

specsFolder.description: Relative or absolute path to a folder with OpenAPI spec files (JSON or YAML). The folder is scanned recursively.

reportUnmatchedRequests.description: Set to true to list requests that don't match any of the OpenAPI specs in the report.
